mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.8% over the past month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.8%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO), manufacturing output contraction reduces corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below its 4-quarter moving average indicates a weakening in aggregate demand that reduces corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 falls below its 4-quarter moving average, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a housing market boom (HOUST above 1500 thousand units), rising residential investment (RSAFS) amplifies consumer wealth effects and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction over the last 3 years is below 0.02.
